def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(x != bg for x in row)]
    border_rows = [r for r in rows if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if len(border_rows) != 1:
        return g
    b = border_rows[0]
    pattern_rows = [r for r in rows if r != b]
    if len(pattern_rows) != 2:
        return g
    top, bottom = sorted(pattern_rows)
    target = b + 1 if b > top else b - 1
    for c, (a, d) in enumerate(zip(grid[top], grid[bottom])):
        if a != bg and a == d:
            g[target][c] = a
            g[bottom][c] = bg
    return g

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    horizontal = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                       if row[0] != bg and all(v == row[0] for v in row)), None)
    if horizontal is not None:
        d = horizontal
        color = grid[d][0]
        patterns = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if any(v != bg and v != color for v in row)]
        if len(patterns) != 2:
            return out
        ref, cand = patterns
        target = d + 1 if cand > d else d - 1
        outer = h - 1 if cand > d else 0
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[cand][c]
            if value in (bg, color):
                continue
            if grid[ref][c] == value:
                out[target][c] = value
                out[cand][c] = bg
            else:
                out[outer][c] = value
        return out
    d = next(c for c in range(w)
             if grid[0][c] != bg and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    color = grid[0][d]
    patterns = [c for c in range(w)
                if any(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != color for r in range(h))]
    if len(patterns) != 2:
        return out
    ref, cand = patterns
    outer = 0 if ref < d else w - 1
    for r in range(h):
        value = grid[r][cand]
        if value not in (bg, color) and grid[r][ref] != value:
            out[r][outer] = grid[r][ref]
    return out

def transform(grid):

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != bg and len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if horizontal:
        d = horizontal[0]
        color = grid[d][0]
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(x not in (bg, color) for x in grid[r])]
        if len(rows) != 2:
            return g
        reference, changing = rows
        near = d + 1 if changing > d else d - 1
        far = h - 1 if changing > d else 0
        for c in range(w):
            x = grid[changing][c]
            if x in (bg, color):
                continue
            g[changing][c] = bg
            destination = near if grid[reference][c] == x else far
            g[destination][c] = x
        return g
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != bg and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if len(vertical) != 1:
        return g
    d = vertical[0]
    color = grid[0][d]

        g[r][changing] = bg
